display.purpose: Strong section headlines and the hero name.

body.purpose: Readable biography, project descriptions, and contact guidance.

label.purpose: Navigation, metadata, periods, filters, and interface labels.

motion.name: editorial-rise
motion.purpose: Reveal sections and project rows as they enter the reading flow.

motion.name: hero-drift
motion.purpose: Subtle scroll drift on the framed hero portrait.

motion.name: ease-editorial
motion.purpose: Confident, quiet movement for hover and menu transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action for contact and form submission.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--editorial-ink); color: var(--editorial-paper); font: 600 0.7rem var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action for downloads and supporting paths.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--editorial-line); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--editorial-ink); font: 600 0.7rem var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Line Field
components.description: Minimal contact field with an underline and clear focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.45rem; color: var(--editorial-muted); font: 500 0.66rem var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { padding: 0.65rem 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--editorial-line); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--editorial-ink); font: 400 1rem var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Editorial Navigation
components.description: Clear text navigation with one active underline and no pill controls.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2rem; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 0.35rem 0; color: var(--editorial-muted); font: 500 0.68rem var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--editorial-coral); }

components.name: Hero Portrait
components.description: Framed monochrome portrait with restrained editorial metadata.
components.css: .ds-hero-portrait { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--editorial-line); background: var(--editorial-surface); } .ds-hero-portrait img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; filter: grayscale(1) contrast(0.92); }

narrative.overview: The portfolio behaves like a well-edited design publication: strong typography, generous breathing room, precise rules, and real work as the visual proof. The home pairs a clear typographic introduction with a framed monochrome portrait, then moves through biography, education, projects, and contact with a steady reading rhythm. Bilingual content, light/dark themes, accessible navigation, CV downloads, contact form, and direct project routes remain part of the experience.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal and warm paper form the base; muted sage is the only accent.
Large display type creates hierarchy without oversized decorative blocks.
One-pixel rules and open space establish the page rhythm.
Mono labels keep metadata, filters, locations, and navigation scannable.
Motion is quiet and purposeful, with reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Sage is a guide, never the main event. Use it for one small decision at a time: active state, index, focus, or action.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Display type carries the personality; mono labels carry the system. Neither should impersonate the other.

rules.name: The Breathing Room Rule
rules.body: Use measured gaps between sections so each chapter has a clear beginning and the work gets a deliberate entrance.

dos: Let project imagery, titles, and descriptions carry the proof.
Use whitespace, rules, and type scale to create hierarchy.
Keep the accent desaturated and purposeful.
Preserve visible focus, skip navigation, language switching, themes, and reduced motion.
Test the hero, navigation, and long section gaps at desktop and mobile widths.
donts: Don't reintroduce bright red/yellow blocks, gradients, or decorative background noise.
Don't turn every control into a rounded pill.
Don't use a large shadow or floating card to compensate for weak hierarchy.
Don't let metadata compete with the person, name, or work.
